title: Implement FT-001 ActorContext and role policy
verify: ActorContext resolves request_id, session, account, Farm, membership, role, auth provenance, and PlantPermissionContext interface envelope before business logic.
Role preset policy matches Boss, Engineer, and Consultant authority from FT-001.
Consultant cannot operate, create domain task/recommendation records, approve governance by default, or approve physical actions.

PlantPermissionContext includes plant_id, plant_status, can_read, can_comment, can_operate, can_create_domain_tasks, can_manage_access, can_approve_actions, source, and optional grant_id, and remains compatible with the canonical resolver contract.

FT-001 implements the canonical active/archived permission effect through fail-closed resolver adapters or test fixtures, but does not implement PlantAccessGrant persistence/mutations, archive/restore mutations, or retained-history workflows.
T3 closure should consider /verify, /red-verify, a human checkpoint, and wave-boundary /mb-sync; these are advisory unless the owner makes a concrete gate mandatory.

commands: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q with three unavailable PostgreSQL/psql prerequisite checks deselected
verify.summary: Functional verification passed. ActorContext and PlantPermissionContext match the canonical bounded interface; role, active/archived, Consultant, missing/revoked/mismatched grant, provider-failure, no-leak, and auth-material hygiene behavior is proven by 15 focused tests and source inspection. The non-environment suite passed 59 tests. The full-suite attempt had three unrelated infrastructure failures because local PostgreSQL and psql are unavailable; no TASK-008 assertion failed.

Semantic verification failed. ActorContext is top-level frozen, but its nested permission resolver keeps mutable role, Farm, Membership, status, and provider authority. A runtime probe changed an Engineer resolver to Boss after resolution, producing source=boss_role and elevating management/action-approval flags while ActorContext still identified the Engineer role. The focused suite does not cover this contradictory authorization state. An expired ValidatedSession was also accepted from a custom validator, exposing an implicit validator postcondition that should be clarified during repair.
verify.recommended_next_action: /execute TASK-008-T3-FT-001-W2 authorization-immutability repair, then repeat /verify and /red-verify; do not promote TASK-009

commands: hostile ActorContext nested-provider repr leakage probe
verify.summary: Repeated semantic verification confirms the original mutable-resolver privilege escalation is repaired and focused tests pass 16/16. A remaining latent T3 context-hygiene concern prevents semantic-pass: generated ActorContext repr recursively exposes the injected snapshot provider, and a hostile provider repr containing a synthetic token_hash marker appeared verbatim in repr(actor). No production FT-002 provider exists yet, so this is semantic-concern rather than semantic-fail. The prior functional PASS predates the repair and remains stale.
verify.recommended_next_action: /execute TASK-008-T3-FT-001-W2 safe-repr repair, then fresh /verify and /red-verify; do not promote TASK-009

verify.owner_decision: The user explicitly instructed the top-level agent to close TASK-008 as completed under the advisory T2/T3 policy and accepted the documented latent safe-repr exposure, stale independent verification, and PostgreSQL/psql environment gap as residual risk.
verify.summary: TASK-008 is closed by the explicit manual owner. The repaired authorization boundary blocks ordinary post-resolution authority mutation and passes 16 focused tests plus 60 non-environment tests. The owner accepts the remaining provider-repr concern and stale independent verify as non-blocking under the advisory policy.
verify.recommended_next_action: Keep TASK-009 planned until a separate readiness decision; perform /mb-sync at the W2 boundary if useful.

verify.owner_decision: The owner accepts the absence of a dedicated hostile-provider regression test as residual risk for the centralized repr repair.
verify.summary: Repeated FT-001 feature-level adversarial review confirms the historical TASK-008 provider-repr concern is repaired: ActorContext and its nested snapshot provider are excluded from generated repr output, the direct hostile probe passes, and the full non-environment suite passes 105/105. This reconciles current code/evidence without rewriting the historical task verdicts or closure decision.
